messages.subject: UAE / Saudi Arabia Executive Profile | Government Relations, Communications & Strategic Partnerships
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Syassi,

I am introducing my profile for senior and confidential leadership mandates across the UAE, Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC. Your role leading Carter Murray across the Middle East and Africa, together with your coverage of government and non-profit, communications, business development and senior executive recruitment, makes this a particularly relevant introduction.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and sustainability, external and corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships, social performance, reputation-sensitive engagement and executive advisory within a major mining and infrastructure environment.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head, Country Director or Representative, Executive Director and VP-track appointments where government relations, public affairs, corporate communications, strategic partnerships, ESG and country strategy intersect. I am especially interested in UAE and Saudi mandates involving government-linked entities, major corporates, infrastructure, natural resources and strategic transformation.

I am internationally mobile, open to expatriate and residential assignments, and available on 30 days' notice. My GCC-focused executive CV is attached for consideration across suitable current or confidential Carter Murray mandates.

Preferred reply address: ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
https://ragunauthramsaroop.com/
https://www.linkedin.com/in/ragunauth-ramsaroop/
